title: Goal Revelation as a Bridge Between Information-Theoretic Empowerment and Capability-Based Human Power
abstract: arXiv:2611.07247v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Power matters for AI safety. Optimal agents tend to acquire power across a wide range of objectives (instrumental convergence). As we embed AI agents into socio-technical systems, humans risk gradual disempowerment. Both concerns call for a formal, quantitative measure of power. Two such measures in the context of Markov games are information-theoretic empowerment, the capacity of the channel from an agent's actions to future states, and capability-based individual power, a measure of goal attainment built from the probabilities that a human would attain each goal in a family of candidates were they pursuing it. We show where the two meet. From individual power, Fano's inequality yields a floor $B(s)$. This floor is a lower bound on what we term goal revelation, the mutual information $\mathbb{I}(G;\xi \mid s)$ between the human's latent goal and the realised trajectory. Empowerment caps revelation from above, so that $B(s) \le \mathbb{I

translated_title: 目标揭示：连接信息论赋权与基于能力的人类权力的桥梁
translated_abstract: 权力对AI安全至关重要。最优智能体往往会在广泛的目标上获取权力（即工具性趋同）。随着我们将AI智能体嵌入社会技术系统，人类面临着逐渐失权的风险。这两种担忧都呼唤一种形式化、定量化的权力度量。在马尔可夫博弈的背景下，存在两种这样的度量：其一是信息论赋权，即从智能体动作到未来状态的信道容量；其二是基于能力的个体权力，这是一种由“人类在追求候选目标族中的每个目标时达成该目标的概率”所构建的目标达成度量。我们展示了这两种度量在何处交汇。从个体权力出发，Fano不等式给出了一个下界 $B(s)$。该下界是我们所称的“目标揭示”的下界——目标揭示即人类潜在目标与实际实现轨迹之间的互信息 $\mathbb{I}(G;\xi \mid s)$。而赋权则从上方对目标揭示加以约束，使得 $B(s) \le \mathbb{I}$……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“目标揭示”（即人类潜在目标与实际轨迹之间的互信息）作为统一两种权力度量的桥梁：基于能力的个体权力通过Fano不等式构成其下界，而信息论赋权构成其上界，从而为AI安全中的权力量化研究建立了理论联系。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "goal revelation"—the mutual information between a human's latent goal and the realised trajectory—as a bridge unifying two power measures for AI safety, showing that capability-based individual power lower-bounds it via Fano's inequality while information-theoretic empowerment upper-bounds it.
